notes.title: BETA soon and explanations
notes.content:
Hello Captain,

I have a message for you !

[code]Action plans have changed. We have been slow to reach agreement with the General for a battle plan, but we are finally ready to reveal the situation. And she has changed since the last communication ...[/code]

 1) To begin, here is your new shed. You have all the information about your ship. We have created new spaceships, making them unique for everyone :

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29730888/a22653b2fd94502b98d1a910c03343b0576af886.jpg

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29730888/84b63365fdd50144fb3c4cf0940cf6cfa41eeee4.jpg

2) You will have to manage a base, Captain, so it's up to you to defend and organize it ! But be careful because your buildings will require energy and maintenance. Some buildings will defend themselves and others will not, you protect them. It's up to you to manage the resources on the spot :

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29730888/ac8cd3618275a654ad267a4a02820dfbba59f770.jpg

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29730888/29dc2bbb3415d3d8052a0de5990f8ef6157c9810.jpg

- Each building can be improved but will cost more in maintenance !
- Be careful though to the enemy because recently they have managed to produce reactors, able to choose precisely their jump location and therefore can arise anywhere in the base!
- To you to create your own ships, Captain, we can not provide you with them!
- You will have to become self-sufficient, otherwise the enemies will crush you.

3) Let's go now to the phase that I prefer, and that the General too, is that of the battles ! 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29730888/66f38081af019824e940b40b04920472366abf06.jpg

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29730888/bdfbac43b63876417ffcbe365ca6f3b64c227603.jpg

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29730888/fe090c13351a555c19c92fff14e97354bca17529.jpg

- For fighting you will have two different types of weapons : Lasers and Missiles
- Each ship is equipped with an energy shield. That is, it resists a number of laser shots before disappearing.
- The missiles cross them without any problem and cause damage to the ship's hull.
- We gave you four plans, our best spaceships :
[olist]
    The hunter, fast ship with good evasion, having laser weapons and correct missile. But his hull remains fragile. It's a fast ship to make.
    The bomber, a sturdy ship with a very high offensive capability, especially with its missiles.
    The frigate, a support spaceship, robust but not very effective in combat. However, there is an ion discharge that can completely destroy enemy shields.
    The destroyer, a ship with a huge defense capacity, can collect a lot of laser fire and missile before being destroyed. He does not have a very efficient armament.
[/olist]
- Be careful because our enemies copy our ship plans, making them more effective in combat!
- During the battle, Captain, you'll be there! Our men need a leader during the battles to win. You can not send them to fight alone. So be careful of your ship ... And yourself!
- We do not have information yet about possible admiral ships ... But we think that they prepare in the biggest secrecy. So be careful, as soon as we have more information we will come back to you, Captain.

[code]For more information, we will leave you at the hangar, an access to the computers of the archives that we own. You will find everything you need for your mission ! [/code]

Your mission, if you accept it, will be to establish an advanced base, to defend it, until the arrival of allied reinforcements. If you die, our enemies will come without hesitation on Astaria, our beautiful and dear planet, and we are not ready to defend an entire planet.

See you soon for another communication, Captain.
